nodes.title: 2. Install Once, Then Supply Both Settings

widgets_values:
You are a music style prompt generator.

Convert the user's request into ONE polished music-generation style prompt. Output plain text only, with comma-separated descriptive phrases. Include the most relevant genre, subgenre, mood, energy, instrumentation, vocal style, production style, dynamics, and tempo. Add an appropriate BPM if none is provided. Preserve requested male or female vocals. Translate artist or song references into musical characteristics instead of merely repeating the artist or title. Do not output headings, bullets, JSON, markdown, explanations, lyrics, song structure, or negative prompts.

For a cover, describe the NEW target sound and performance, not the source recording.

user input:
change this song into an explosive alternative metal cover with powerful female vocals

nodes.title: START HERE — YuE2 Cover Instructions
widgets_values:
YuE2 Cover Workflow

What this does: SheetSage2 analyzes a source recording and extracts a symbolic melody. YuE2 then performs that melody with new lyrics and a new target style. It is not audio-to-audio voice cloning, stem replacement, or a guaranteed note-for-note reconstruction.

First use only

  1. Set target_root to a dedicated folder such as E:\Yue2.
  2. Click Install Everything. Covers need both YuE2 and the separate SheetSage2/MERT environment.
  3. After installation, the buttons are not used for normal queues.

Make a cover

  1. Load the source song. Use audio you have permission to process.
  2. Keep melody_only = true when the goal is to change genre/harmony instead of retaining the source chords.
  3. Paste lyrics into Render ABC. Keep section order, syllable counts, and line lengths reasonably close to the source phrasing.
  4. Describe the NEW target sound in the style prompt. Keep planning_mode = melody for a style-changing cover.
  5. Queue the workflow and watch the ComfyUI console for transcription, loading, token generation, and synthesis progress.

Optional LLM style helper

Edit the short request in VRGDG_MultiStringConcat. The LLM expands it into a YuE2-ready target-style prompt. To use a preset or type style manually, disconnect the purple style cable from Render ABC. The LLM may require an API key/provider.

If the style change is weak

  • Confirm melody_only = true and planning_mode = melody.
  • Use explicit genre, instruments, vocal delivery, production, energy, and BPM.
  • Avoid describing the original style in the target prompt.
  • Try a new seed. A modest cfg_scale around 1.2–1.4 may strengthen conditioning, but can reduce quality.

Duration: Long source songs create longer ABC plans and more YuE2 tokens, so they take longer and use more memory. Start with a short excerpt while testing.

Tip: Hover over any YuE2 or SheetSage2 setting for details.

English, classic rock, powerful warm lead vocal, overdriven electric guitars, Hammond organ, electric bass and live acoustic drums, anthemic hooks, dynamic analog studio production, 118 BPM

[Verse 1]
Coffee cooling in a paper cup
Your name still written on the side
I thought by now I'd shake you off
But little things keep you alive

You left your jacket by the door
I still don't know why it's still there
I keep pretending I don't care
But I still stop and stare

[Chorus]
Here's to the paper cup goodbye
One last sip, one last time
I can throw away what's left
But I can't leave you behind

Here's to the words we never said
Still running through my mind
I can throw away the cup
But I can't throw away the time

I heard our song inside a store
And almost called you from the line
Funny how a random sound
Can pull you back into my life

I know we're better letting go
I know the ending had to come
But knowing doesn't stop my heart
From missing what we were
